propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets that are invisible to the P1 blocking floor and cannot be individually checkable or tagged with [operator-attested].
Success Criteria blocks must be migrated to Acceptance Criteria as checkbox items (- [ ]) to make them countable and verifiable by _count_ac_items and support plan-review attestation.

The migration script must rewrite ticket descriptions through rebar.edit_ticket (not direct git edits), preserve audit trail, and default to dry-run with an explicit flag for non-closed tickets to avoid invalidating in-flight claims.
Material changes to ticket descriptions invalidate stale plan-review attestations, requiring the migration to skip in-flight claimed work unless explicitly approved.
Post-migration verification must confirm zero Success Criteria headings remain, all 106 migrated tickets pass the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1), and no tickets are missing or corrupted.
